This quest [1547] is called 'War and Peace',
for Adventurers levels 20 to 50.
Lord Agrippa is the master in charge of this quest.
Lately in the elegant and classy town of Rune, the wild animals have
become angry with my Knight, Sir Tristan, and me.  The reason for their
anger towards us, to my knowledge, is because they are not being fed enough!
Please recover some food from the local bakery and give it to these animals!
I have heard that the deer like danish, while other animals enjoy eating
other types of food!  Please recover these food items and give them to the
animals before they take over Rune and wage war!  
Upon successful completion of this quest you can receive:
*Up to 29 quest points, 3 practice points, 17,010 experience points,
0 build points, 0 piety, 1 alignment, and 4,140 gold pieces.
This quest has no time limit.
War and Peace consists of:
Phase 1: Journey to The Edible Loaf [Towne of Rune].
Phase 2: Locate and deliver a waybread [Towne of Rune] to a stray dog [Towne of Rune].
Phase 3: Locate and deliver a blueberry danish to a deer.
Phase 4: Locate and deliver a baguette [Towne of Rune] to an alley cat [Towne of Rune].
Phase 5: (Hidden until previous goal is completed)
'May your journey be a successful one, Hero!' Lord Agrippa exclaims.
